Family Nurse Practitioner MSN Program

Make the transition from BSN to MSN seamlessly with our fully online MSN in Family Nurse Practitioner program. Designed with the working professional in mind, we recognize that our students often juggle full-time work, family commitments, and other responsibilities, so you can integrate your studies around your life. We prioritize student success with a supportive, adaptable learning environment tailored to your needs.

100% Online

We offer our small online class sizes so professors are accessible to students. In this format, you will gain a deep understanding of the subject matter.

No Entrance Exam

Our Admissions application doesn’t require the GMAT or GRE. We streamline the application process so you can get started on your MSN quickly.

Full or Part-Time

Most MSN graduates earn this degree in as few as 18 months. There is a full- or part-time option for those entering the program with an RN degree.
